title: Albert Einstein
text:
Albert Einstein was born in Ulm, Germany, in 1879. As a child, he liked music, and he played the violin. He did not like school very much, but he loved mathematics. He liked to solve problems on his own.

In 1902, Einstein got a job at a patent office in Bern, Switzerland. He worked there for several years. In his free time, he wrote about new ideas in physics. In 1921, he won the Nobel Prize in Physics.

questions.text: What job did Einstein get in 1902?
options: A job at a patent office

questions.text: What can you infer about Einstein as a child?
options: He was curious about numbers and problems
He wanted to be a singer
He did not play any instrument

questions.text: What does the passage suggest about Einstein's free time at the patent office?
options: He wanted to learn and write about physics
He spent all his time with his family
He stopped writing down his ideas

vocabulary.definition: a musical instrument that you play with a bow
the study of numbers, shapes and problems
an official right that protects a new invention

paragraph_translations: Albert Einstein, 1879'da Almanya'nın Ulm kentinde doğdu. Çocukken müziği severdi ve keman çalardı. Okulu pek sevmezdi ama matematiği çok severdi. Problemleri kendi başına çözmekten hoşlanırdı.

1902'de Einstein, İsviçre'nin Bern kentindeki bir patent ofisinde iş buldu. Orada birkaç yıl çalıştı ve boş zamanlarında fizik hakkında yeni fikirler yazdı. 1921'de Fizik dalında Nobel Ödülü'nü kazandı.
